analysis_rows.symptom: Blog traffic declines for tech articles over time
analysis_rows.cause: Technology evolves rapidly making content obsolete without regular updates
analysis_rows.evidence: Raft article example generated 100+ visits/day initially but traffic dropped due to lack of updates over years
analysis_rows.fix: Implement consistent update schedule: review every 6 months, subscribe to manufacturer newsletters, follow developer social media, set Google Alerts, rewrite every 3 years

analysis_rows.symptom: Blog reputation damaged by outdated information
analysis_rows.cause: Readers quickly identify and report obsolete tools features or discontinued products in articles
